label: late original-phase input of l/p/i/x
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, never at t<3, on <DEL>, or in the copy phase. The firing rate climbs steeply with position (orig_idx 3: 0.2%, orig_idx 8: 14%), so longer sequences carry most of the mass (L=9 holds 52%). Within that window the input token matters most: l (7.8x lift, 30% of mass) and p (6.5x, 23%), then i and x (~3.6x), with weaker contributions from 3, 1, o, z. Mostly fires on the first occurrence of a token (86% of mass). The strongest activations (~0.13) are l or p at t=7-8, often in sequences that begin with e or y; first token e has 4.3x lift, but a history condition on e/y did not improve the fit. Gating on position and token alone leaves many false positives: the same late l/p/i/x is often inactive, so some unidentified history dependence decides whether it fires. Position (t>=4) alone covers 99% of mass at 5% precision.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: l, p, i, x, 3, 1; least: y, e, u, j) and the first original token (most: e, y, j, b, 0, k; least: 1, x, l, p); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, L=9 & t=8, t=7.
